findings.issue: All three default adapter constructors fail because upstream dependency 'ta' is absent and not declared in pyproject.toml.
findings.required_remediation: Add a governed, version-bounded 'ta' dependency and prove clean-environment/default construction for all three adapters without network-dependent runtime installation.
findings.evidence: SMCScalperAdapter, TrendBreakTraumaAdapter and CRTTBSAdapter each raise RuntimeError before initialization; importlib reports ta unavailable.

findings.issue: Behavioral parity is not demonstrated against the real pinned strategy classes.
findings.required_remediation: After governing the dependency, add deterministic direct-pinned-versus-adapter parity fixtures for each strategy, covering defaults, no-signal and signal paths, session/state behavior, warmup, and fresh-instance replay.
findings.evidence: All signal/default/determinism tests inject RecordingUpstream mocks; because ta is absent, no test executes a pinned analyze path or compares direct-upstream and adapter outputs/state on identical causal fixtures.

findings.issue: Adapter output validation permits cross-symbol contamination.
findings.required_remediation: Fail closed unless emitted symbol equals the validated requested XAUUSD symbol; add wrong/missing symbol, unsupported direction, non-finite prices and malformed output regressions.
findings.evidence: An XAUUSD request with an injected upstream signal carrying symbol EURUSD returns a valid BUY SignalProposal for EURUSD.

findings.issue: The complete repository suite is not green at the review commit.
findings.required_remediation: Route the two pre-existing governance failures through a separate bounded remediation and obtain a clean complete-suite result before adapter acceptance.
findings.evidence: 684 passed, 2 failed, 13 warnings; failures are governance example/transition assertions in tests/governance/test_agent_orchestration_design.py.
